about: The threads of the Atlas timeline: named storylines that run across the ages. An annals event names the threads it belongs to in "threads": [id, ...]. Writers add threads through the lead; a new thread needs an id (lower-case words joined by hyphens), its Dia-thìris name (dt, which passes rodais_engine.normalize() and check_agreement(), and agrees with eras/NAMES.json), an English gloss, a colour and one sentence of description. status: canon (the name is attested in the master record) or proposed (the name awaits the lead's confirmation against NAMES.json).

threads.description: Neachdan the mason and his descendants, from the first fire to the end of the line.
Aisling and her line, as the copyists kept it.
The seven coals of the vein: their finding, their lighting, their rule and their failing.
The Stone Kings of the Age of Ailean and what was remembered of them.
The Roinn: the sharing of the land among the heirs and the shares' long history.
The promise of Coimhdeach na Fine, the Keeper of the Kin, and how it was kept or broken.
The coal-blooded: who carried the coal in their blood, and what became of them.
The humans' faith on the island, from the first chapel to the Church of the present day.
An Cogadh Fada, the Long War of the Age of Dubhan: its causes, campaigns and peace.
The Library at Muileann chaol and the record it keeps.
The humans' Company: its charter, camps, quays and coal ships.
Manannan's mist, which hid the island from the ships beyond it, and its thinning.
The Tuathaich: their homeland, their shires and their part in the Kingdom.
